name: Instrument: Build the composition statement and the reach read's record (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)

The statement's five sentences as one paragraph on the team home in every house language once A5 is ratified, with no sentence beyond it until `86akh7r8z` is ruled; the read's fields on the leads' review record (source dominance per seat and count of reviews; stage rate per stage and source or chosen language), the acts taken and their record, the dominance count as a reset parameter, and the self-identification rule if the founders rule one (voluntary, after the packet, invisible to every assessor, decider, lead, and mentor, aggregate only, never joined to a person page, form and retention counsel's); feeds rows 139 and 140; carries no name and produces an act on the sheet or the calibration record and nothing on a candidate. High. Gated on `86ajgn2z5`, A5, `86akh7r8z`, `86akh9tbd`, and counsel.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
